svg.title: Skills transfer in three phases
svg.desc: Five modules in three phases. I do, watch us: foundations, then one of your App-V packages through App Attach. We do, pair on your packages: convert to MSIX, then fix and troubleshoot. You do, lead while we review: run it as a service, until your team converts, signs, tests and onboards a package with no help. Three roles share the work: platform engineer, packager, and tester and app owner.
